panel.label: Scene options
panel.name: scene_options_tab
panel.text: F2 toggle console · F3 ACTION / CUT · F4 CUT · F5 reset to marks · F6 pose ghosts on/off · F7 take play/pause · F8 set marks · 1-9 punch camera-switcher slots (console visible, switcher armed, no text focus) · Alt+1-9 punch Anim Switchboard slots (console open, switchboard armed, no text focus) · Esc CUT while running (console focused). F-keys work while the Director or Actor Mover is open; F2 works always.

Cast, marks, groups and start delays, locomotion roles, subjects A-D, actor paths, per-actor gaze targets, performance and gaze cues, Actor FX styles; transport arming; camera switcher program; Flycam Orbit; Cinematic camera mode and preset; frame/lens guide; Actor Mover settings; Temporal capture modes; Virtual Cam captures/displays/gate; light rigs, Rig Rim, Roto Ink, Tron. Not saved yet: exposure/tonemap, lens looks, DoF, depth haze, projector shafts, weather, scene-light EVs, Pose Polish, Diopter.

text.tool_tip: Recorder capture indicator: red while a take is being captured

panel.name: legend_panel
panel.text:
Status column: a walking figure means the actor is moving, a green dot means idle and in world, a gray dot means the actor is not in world (shown "(away)").
AB column: A marks Subject A and B marks Subject B, the bodies the cinematic camera frames. Set them from the cast right-click menu, Camera > Shot, or by double-clicking a cast row (sets Subject A).
M column: a flag means a mark (a saved position) is set for that actor.
L column: L marks a cast member flagged for the local Look at camera override (Camera > Shot). The master toggle must also be on; ghosts and animesh are never affected.
Groups: the dot-suffix after a name is the member's group tag (set in the Group box under the list); the Move tab's Start/Stop group drive every member of a group at once.
Paths: each actor's in-world path preview and its numbered nodes are drawn in a stable per-actor color, so overlapping routes stay readable.
Hotkeys: see Capture > Scene options.
